text: Gan Assurances is a subsidiary of the Groupama group.
short: Gan Assurances is a subsidiary of the Groupama group

source.name: Groupama press space — Publicité : Gan Assurances, filiale du Groupe Groupama, reprend la parole à la télévision pour accompagner sa croissance
source.quote: Publicité : Gan Assurances, filiale du Groupe Groupama, reprend la parole à la télévision pour accompagner sa croissance
source.note: Translation: 'Advertising: Gan Assurances, a subsidiary of the Groupama Group, returns to television to accompany its growth' (Groupama's press space, 21 September 2026).

additionalSources.name: Gan Assurances — Qui sommes-nous ?
additionalSources.quote: Gan Assurances fait partie du Groupe Groupama et participe à permettre au plus grand nombre de construire leur vie en confiance
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Gan Assurances is part of the Groupama group and helps the greatest number to build their lives with confidence.' The page shows no publication date; its advertising campaign section refers to September 2026.

additionalSources.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Gan Assurances (Groupe Groupama) renoue avec le cyclisme (communiqué officiel)
additionalSources.quote: Gan Assurances (Groupe Groupama) renoue avec le cyclisme
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Gan Assurances (Groupama group) returns to cycling.' The club's own announcement titles Gan Assurances as part of the Groupama group.
